description: Defines classes and types for managing datagram buffers, including a pool allocator and buffer objects, used for efficient socket IO operations in Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: DatagramBuffer
classes.description: Represents a buffer for datagram data, with methods for data access and management, intended to be created via DatagramBufferPool.

classes.name: DatagramBufferPool
classes.description: A pooling allocator for DatagramBuffer objects, managing buffer reuse to optimize memory and performance.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds a copy of data to the pool, to be used in DatagramBuffers.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Returns all buffers to the pool for reuse.

methods.name: max_buffer_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum buffer size allowed in the pool.
